name: The Canyon Suites at The Phoenician
insider_take: This exclusive adults-only retreat sits like a crown jewel atop the Sonoran Desert, where luxury meets the rugged beauty of Camelback Mountain.
whats_special: The Canyon Suites occupies the most elevated position at The Phoenician resort, offering unparalleled privacy with only 60 casita-style suites. Each suite features its own private entrance and many boast stunning views of Camelback Mountain's distinctive "camel hump" silhouette. The property's desert botanical gardens showcase over 600 varieties of cacti and desert plants, including some specimens that are over 100 years old.
pro_tip: Book a suite on the mountain-facing side during winter months – you'll catch incredible sunrises over Camelback Mountain while enjoying your morning coffee on your private patio.
dont_miss: The exclusive Canyon Concierge Lounge with complimentary breakfast and evening cocktails, plus priority access to The Phoenician Spa's rooftop relaxation pool. Take the short hike to Camelback Mountain's Echo Canyon Trail – one of Arizona's most photographed hiking spots is literally in your backyard.
pros: Ultra-luxurious suites with spacious layouts and premium amenities
Exclusive Canyon Building with private pools and elevated service
Access to world-class spa and championship golf courses
Stunning Sonoran Desert and Camelback Mountain views
Multiple award-winning dining venues and luxury shopping
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects ultra-high-end positioning
Desert location may be very warm during summer months
